北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京中雨，体感 9℃ 较凉，出门别忘带伞，多添衣物哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Moderate rain in Beijing, feels chilly at 9℃. Don't forget your umbrella and warm layers!
北京.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波晴朗，气温 24℃ 舒适。微风拂面，享受阳光，记得多喝水！
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo is sunny and a comfortable 24℃. Enjoy the breeze and stay hydrated!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，气温 24℃ 挺舒服的，记得适当饮水，保持好心情！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, a pleasant 24℃. Stay hydrated and keep smiling!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光灿烂，体感 29℃ 偏热，外出记得防晒补水哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and feels hot at 29℃. Remember sun protection and hydration!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗炎热，体感 28℃，风力稍大。外出注意防晒和补水！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and warm, 28℃ with some wind. Stay protected from sun and hydrate!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有雾，体感 24℃ 较暖，出行请注意交通安全哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy, a warm 24℃. Please drive safely on your commute!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，风力 5级 较大，体感 20℃ 略凉，出门注意防风保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is overcast, feels cool at 20℃ with strong winds. Dress warmly and beware of wind!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，18℃ 湿度 100%，体感微凉。记得保持心情舒畅哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, 18℃ with 100% humidity. Stay cheerful despite the dampness!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，风力 4级。体感 22℃ 略凉，出行请注意安全哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy with moderate wind. Feels cool at 22℃. Please travel safely!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安小雨，体感 9℃ 较冷。出门记得带伞，多添衣物，注意保暖！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an has light rain, feels cold at 9℃. Take an umbrella and dress warmly!
西安.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降7℃

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，体感 24℃ 偏暖。出行注意安全，保持好心情！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy, a warm 24℃. Travel safely and keep your spirits high!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，气温 8℃，体感 6℃。早晚温差大，注意添衣保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but cold at 6℃. Mind the temperature difference and dress warmly!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天，体感 10℃ 略凉，风力 3级。注意防风，及时增减衣物。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and feels cool at 10℃ with wind. Dress appropriately for the breeze!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，体感 15℃ 舒适。阳光正好，享受美好时光，记得补水！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and a pleasant 15℃. Enjoy the beautiful weather and stay hydrated!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 28℃ 偏热，紫外线较强。注意防晒，及时补水！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels warm at 28℃. Protect from sun and remember to hydrate!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，风力 6级 强劲，体感 19℃ 较凉。出门注意防风保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is overcast, feels cool at 19℃ with strong winds. Dress warmly and stay safe!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，风力 5级 较大，体感 18℃ 略凉。外出请注意防风保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels cool at 18℃ with strong winds. Dress warmly when heading out!

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦有雾，体感 25℃ 较暖。出行请务必小心，注意交通安全！
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is foggy, a warm 25℃. Please take extra care and travel safely!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阳光正好，体感 25℃ 舒适。享受美好天气，注意补水哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny and feels great at 25℃! Enjoy the day and stay hydrated.
